item.title: Pierce Manufacturing Expands FL Operations
item.description: Pierce Manufacturing is investing $150 million in facility enhancements in Bradenton, FL, adding 800 jobs and expanding production capacity to meet growing demand for fire apparatus. item.title: NC Firefighter Dies After Medical Emergency at Fire Scene
item.description: Firefighter Dale Malone, 66, of the White Level Rural Fire Department, died on Feb. 10 after a medical emergency while responding to a fire. The cause of death is undetermined.
